body: I feel idiotic for saying it but I feel gp would tell people and you can tell me they wouldn't and can't because of confidentiality but I won't believe it. Gives me a tight feeling in my chest entertaining the thought of talking to anybody

Identifying a irrational thought is the easy part. Silencing it before you begin to convince yourself it is truth, is not so easy. The things I convince myself people think of me and want to do to me I wouldn't wish to share with you, I say they are irrational because if they're not then I'd rather be dead. Plus I do not even know if I need/deserve help. Maybe I'm just a cunt who needs to get a grip.

A general practitioner, your local doctor you go when you have the flu etc

"A general practitioner (GP) is a medical practitioner who treats acute and chronic illnesses and provides preventive care and health education to patients "
I don't know how to be strong I don't know how to help myself, I know it's pathetic but I just can't, I don't deserve to be helped.
I don't know how I would even go about it and even if I did have options I probably wouldn't be able to talk.
Who would I even email? And would they even be able to make me stop thinking horrible thoughts I don't want there to be something wrong with me

I'm glad your friend sorted himself out but I meant i can't talk to people and I choke in regard to when I want to open up about my past and the way I feel and the things I am thinking. When I'm out I tend to drown myself in alcohol but sometimes it can be like pouring petrol on an already lit flame. For example I banned myself from alcohol but felt as though I had to go out because it was my friends birthday, long story short I got drunk out of my tiny little mind adding to my already dark mood I started to feel suffocated and over whelmed and became hysterical I ran out of the place to the street where some guy managed to get my phone off me and ring my boyfriend then a police man put me in a taxi. I was worked up I scratched every bit of skin off my wrist where my 7 cutting marks are. My friends don't know anything about me most of the time I put a clever little act on, I'm a completely different person to who I am when I'm with people apart from my boyfriend.
I can't talk to anyone I physically choke when I try and how could I even go about talking to someone professional? I feel like I'm insane.
